title: Nightscout Sync (REST-API) Back-fill not sending calibrations
body:
Back-fill is successfully adding/replacing BG entries, but not calibrations.

I'm not sure about treatments because I don't have any at the moment, but it would be ideal if all types of data that are normally uploaded would be sent with Back-fill, making it possible to migrate between Nightscout instances without losing data.

comments.body:
@thedewi Would you please close this issue if the feature has already been implemented?
